explanation: This fires only at D1 after a rewarded trial, and only when the agent then goes on to choose a1 (0 if it switches to a2, and 0 after any unrewarded trial, at GO and at D2). Its size grows with how late it is in the episode: about 7-10 from trial 87 to 99, about 2-6 around trials 30-85, and usually 0-3 earlier, with some long runs of rewarded a1 choices in mid-episode staying at 0.
